output.summary: Fruit-bearing deciduous shrub native to the Caucasus and Iranian plateau, including modern Iran, Turkmenistan, Afghanistan and Pakistan. Its spiny branches bear bright red or white flowers and thick reddish fruits divided into seed-filled chambers. The fleshy seed coats and pulp are edible; the fruit and juice are used in drinks, baking, cooking and garnishes.
